Loading HiRISE terrain map…

You are an astronaut on Mount Sharp

The ground uses high-resolution orbital terrain data. Walk with W A S D or the arrow keys, drag to look around, V switches first / third person.

The tablet in your hands is Martian Map. Idle, it shows a compass and how dangerous the ground is. Press Tab or M to raise it:

  1. Pick where to go — a science stop, or click its map.
  2. Pick a route — safe, balanced or science.
  3. Go on EVA — walk it yourself or use autopilot, then try an emergency.

Everything runs inside this browser — no network link to Earth needed.
